sa: ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु । सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
iast: oṃ saha nāv avatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai |
tejasvi nāv adhītam astu | mā vidviṣāvahai ||

tr.text: Om! May Brahman protect us both together. May He nourish us both together. May we both work together, with great energy. May our study be vigorous and effective. May we not hate each other. Om! Peace ! Peace ! Peace !
